description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the o_pop frequency (plotted on the x-axis, scaled linearly from 1 to 19 with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2, and labeled as "o_pop frequency (x10^4)") and two measures of accuracy (plotted on the y-axis, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0) for a model, as described in the paper "Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback". The plot displays two distinct lines: a green line with solid markers representing "Initial Accuracy" and a blue line with dashed markers representing "Final Accuracy". The green "Initial Accuracy" line begins at approximately 0.32 when o_pop frequency is 1, rises to a peak of about 0.48 at frequency 5, then declines to a low of approximately 0.28 at frequency 7, before gradually increasing to about 0.42 at frequency 19. The blue "Final Accuracy" line starts at approximately 0.65 at frequency 1, rises to a peak of about 0.88 at frequency 9, then declines to a low of approximately 0.65 at frequency 13, before rising again to a final value of about 0.88 at frequency 19. Both lines exhibit error bars, indicating variability in the measurements.
